Interactive Built-In Rule Catalog

Search by Rule ID, WCAG 2.2 Success Criterion, Section 508 citation, or Guided Fix behavior.

Showing 18 source-level WCAG 2.2 & Revised Section 508 Web rules
Rule ID Severity WCAG 2.2 / Section 508 Assisted Guided Fix Engineering Verification
WCAG-HTML-LANG Serious 3.1.1 Language of Page (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Injects `lang="en"` on `<html>` Detects missing, empty, or malformed BCP 47 `lang` attributes on the root `<html>` element so screen readers load the right pronunciation rules.
WCAG-HTML-TITLE Serious 2.4.2 Page Titled (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Inserts `<title>` in `<head>` Flags HTML documents missing a non-empty `<title>` element announced first when users switch browser tabs or windows.
WCAG-LANDMARK-MAIN Moderate 1.3.1 / 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Manual structural landmark wrap Verifies full HTML5 documents expose a primary `<main>` landmark so assistive technology users can jump straight past repeated chrome.
WCAG-LANDMARK-DUP-NAV Moderate 1.3.1 Info & Relationships (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Adds `aria-label` to `<nav>` Detects multiple `<nav>` regions on the same page that lack distinct `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` names.
WCAG-HEADING-SKIP Moderate 1.3.1 / 2.4.6 Headings & Labels (AA)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Normalizes skipped `<hN>` tag Flags skipped heading ranks (such as jumping from `<h1>` directly to `<h4>`) and empty heading elements.
WCAG-TABLE-FAKE-HEADER Serious 1.3.1 Info & Relationships (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Converts bold `<td>` row to `<th scope="col">` Catches data tables whose first row uses visual bolding (`<td><strong>` or `font-weight: bold`) instead of programmatic `<th>` headers.
WCAG-TABLE-TH-SCOPE Moderate 1.3.1 Info & Relationships (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Adds `scope="col"` to `<th>` Ensures `<th>` header cells declare explicit `scope="col"` or `scope="row"` attributes for unambiguous cell announcements.
WCAG-IMG-MISSING-ALT Critical 1.1.1 Non-text Content (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Adds `alt=""` or descriptive `alt` Flags `<img>` tags missing `alt` attributes or containing raw camera/file-extension filenames (`IMG_4021.jpg`).
WCAG-SVG-UNLABELED Serious 1.1.1 / 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Adds `aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"` Detects inline `<svg>` graphics that neither hide decorative vectors nor provide `role="img"` with an accessible title.
WCAG-FORM-MISSING-LABEL Critical 1.3.1 / 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Injects programmatic `aria-label` Verifies `<input>`, `<select>`, and `<textarea>` controls have an associated `<label for="...">`, wrapping `<label>`, or ARIA label.
WCAG-INPUT-AUTOCOMPLETE Moderate 1.3.5 Identify Input Purpose (AA)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Adds `autocomplete="email"` / `"tel"` Checks personal email and telephone inputs for WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA `autocomplete` tokens aiding users with cognitive or motor disabilities.
WCAG-LINK-GENERIC-TEXT Serious 2.4.4 Link Purpose in Context (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Manual descriptive link copy Flags empty anchors (`<a></a>`) and ambiguous `"click here"` / `"read more"` links lacking descriptive accessible names.
WCAG-ARIA-HIDDEN-FOCUSABLE Critical 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Removes `aria-hidden="true"` Catches focusable `<button>`, `<a>`, or `<input>` controls marked `aria-hidden="true"`, preventing "ghost focus" traps for screen readers.
WCAG-TABINDEX-POSITIVE Serious 2.4.3 Focus Order (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Normalizes to `tabindex="0"` Flags positive `tabindex="1+"` attributes that hijack natural DOM keyboard reading order.
WCAG-MEDIA-CAPTIONS Critical 1.2.2 Captions Prerecorded (A)
Revised 508 E205.4 / ADA Title II		 Inserts `<track kind="captions">` Ensures HTML5 `<video>` players include synchronized WebVTT `<track kind="captions">` tracks and disables `autoplay` audio.
WCAG-CSS-CONTRAST Serious 1.4.3 Contrast Minimum (AA)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Replaces hex with nearest `>= 4.5:1` AA color Evaluates CSS foreground/background pairs (including `:root` custom property tokens) against WCAG 2.2 4.5:1 AA relative luminance.
WCAG-CSS-FOCUS-SUPPRESSED Serious 2.4.7 Focus Visible (AA)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Restores `3px solid currentColor` focus ring Detects CSS rules setting `outline: none` or `outline: 0` without a visible high-contrast focus replacement.
WCAG-VTT-TIMING Serious 1.2.2 Captions Prerecorded (A)
Revised 508 E205.4		 Prepends `WEBVTT` header & flags cue overlaps Validates WebVTT caption tracks for the mandatory `WEBVTT` header, monotonic `start --> end` cue timestamps, overlapping cues, and empty blocks.

Engineering & Licensing FAQ

Key architectural boundaries for enterprise compliance teams.

No—and RaggieSoft Accessibility Studio states this explicitly in every exported HTML5 report. Automated source and DOM checks catch deterministic structural, contrast, labeling, focus-suppression, and WebVTT timing defects rapidly so engineers can focus manual keyboard (Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape) and assistive-technology verification (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver) on real user workflows.

0 = Audit passed threshold; 1 = Usage or I/O error; 2 = One or more accessibility findings met or exceeded your --fail-on severity gate (Critical, Serious, Moderate, or Advisory).
